g.text: Proxy + Chain of Responsibility — as built (UML 2.5.1 class diagram)
+allocate(jobId : String, workerId : String, jobVersion : long) : Allocation
+wrap(iface : Class<T>, target : T, tx : TransactionRunner) : T
+invoke(proxy : Object, method : Method, args : Object[]) : Object
Before: one invoke() did all three jobs and decoded SQLSTATE "23505".
After: each concern is one Interceptor; a new one (timing, per-job authorisation)
